column3: (Re-examine Cache-control Directives: informational; the pages are rendered per request, the API answers are no-store)
(Suspicious Comments: informational; the HTML comments of app.html explain the first-paint theme script)
(Storable and Cacheable Content: informational; the hashed static files are cached on purpose, the API answers are no-store)
(CSP style-src unsafe-inline: Svelte's style attributes and transitions need inline styles; scripts are nonce-only)
(Source Code Disclosure - SQL: a false alarm on /api/translations, whose texts contain words like SELECT and FROM)

(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: not set — the app needs no cross-origin isolation, and it would block the PDF preview frames; CORP and COOP are set, checked by the unit tests of the backend and frontend headers)
